| gpt-6-astra | $10.00 | $50.00 | $1.00 | $12.50 | $25.00 | $20.00 | $75.00 | $2.00 | $25.00 | $50.00 |
| gpt-6.1-sol | $2.00 | $10.00 | $0.10 | $2.50 | $5.00 | $4.00 | $15.00 | $0.20 | $5.00 | $10.00 |

=== 上下文长度分档原文 ===
Short context: ≤272K input tokens. Long context: >272K input tokens.

=== Service tier / 促销原文（Flagship models 表下方）===
Regional processing (data residency) endpoints are charged a 10% uplift for models released on or after March 5, 2026. FedRAMP endpoints are also charged a 10% uplift. Priority processing was renamed Fast mode on July 30, 2026. GPT-5.6 Sol's promotional pricing is available at least through November 21, 2026.

GPT-6.1 Sol / Price / Input: $2.00 / 1M tokens / Cached input: $0.10 / 1M tokens / Output: $10.00 / 1M tokens

Pricing above reflects standard processing rates for context lengths under 272K.

=== 抓取说明 ===
platform.openai.com/docs/pricing 与 developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing 对 Playwright 自带 Chromium 一律返回 Cloudflare 403（"This request was blocked / 403 FORBIDDEN"，developers.openai.com 首页同样 403）；改用本机真实 Chrome（Playwright channel:'chrome'）后 HTTP 200，成功取得正文与同页 .md 版本（/api/docs/pricing.md）互相校验，两处数值完全一致。
